svg.data-power-input: 100-240 VAC per Flex Slot supply (the 865434-B21 supply -48 VDC, the 865428-B21 HVAC/HVDC)
svg.data-psu-redundancy: 1+1 with the redundant power supply enablement kit 866442-B21
svg.data-fans: three single-rotor hot-plug fans with one processor, six with two; one more with the redundant fan kit 866438-B21
svg.data-operating-temp-extended-c: 5 to 10 and 35 to 45, approved configurations only
svg.data-operating-humidity: 8 to 90% non-condensing, 28 C maximum wet bulb
svg.data-cpu: up to two Intel Xeon Scalable processors, first or second generation
svg.data-memory: 16 DDR4 DIMM slots, up to 1.0 TB with 64 GB DIMMs
svg.data-storage-controller: HPE Smart Array S100i embedded (SATA only); Smart Array modular and PCIe controllers optional

rect.data-description: Locate. Solid blue - identified by a host application; flashing blue - carrier firmware updating or needing an update.

circle.data-description: Activity ring. Rotating green - drive activity; off - none. The rotation is drawn as a blink.

circle.data-states: off online rebuild predictive-failure predictive-failure-member fault
circle.data-description: Drive status. Solid green - member of a logical drive; flashing green - rebuilding or migrating; flashing amber - predictive failure, not a member of a logical drive; flashing amber/green - a member of one or more logical drives and predicted to fail; solid amber - failed.

rect.data-description: The release button, which is the do-not-remove lamp - solid white when removing the drive would fail a logical drive.
